concepts.label: Audit Event (Sync Gateway)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the individual, uniquely-numbered log entry Sync Gateway's audit-logging feature produces. First contact with Sync Gateway auditing in this project; checked against security:auditing (Server) and monitoring:event (Capella) and found no page stating an equivalence, so kept as its own concept per the no-silent-merge rule. See this record's cross_product_finding.

notable_absence.finding: This reference page lists ~50 audit event IDs across Auditing, Sync Gateway, Database, User/Role Administration, Replication and Document-related categories, but none of the individual event rows states which privilege or role is required to trigger or view them - that gating fact lives on audit-logging.md ('Viewing and managing audit logs permissions are enforced through Sync Gateway RBAC controls') and manage-audit-logs.md (the cbs/sgw domain split), not here. This page is purely a catalog of what gets recorded, not who can see it. Also notable: Database-scope events are stated to be 'segregated into per Sync Gateway database specific audit logs' but no promoted or minted predicate in this batch cleanly captures that per-database log-file segregation fact (storesDataIn's usual sense is storage-engine placement, not a log-file split, and scopedToKeyspace's range is keyspaces/roles/indexes, not an enum value) - left unrecorded as a relation rather than forced onto an ill-fitting predicate.

cross_component_finding: The EventScope enum (Global vs Database) ties directly into this batch's other two pages' configuration-surface split: Global-scope events are gated through sgw:audit-log-bootstrap-config (file-based, node-level), Database-scope events through sgw:admin-rest-api (runtime, per-database) - the same Global/Database split that manage-audit-logs.md's 'Audit Log Configuration' section describes in full. This page supplies the enum and its two example event IDs; manage-audit-logs.md supplies the operational detail.
cross_product_finding: This page's event catalog (id/name/description/DefaultEnabled/Filterable/EventScope/EventType/Fields, ~50 rows) shares its general shape - a filterable, per-node, timestamped, immutable event log with an Admin/Data/User type split - with Server's security:auditing facility, but the two catalogs share no actual vocabulary: this page's ids are five-digit numbers in the 53000-55999 range specific to Sync Gateway's own operations (database CRUD, ISGR replication, sync-gateway-specific user/role administration), not Server's audit_event ids. No page in this batch, or in the round-3 Sync Gateway security pages read for context, states any equivalence between the two. Also notable: both tool:cbcollect-info (Server's collector, promoted, 'does not collect audit logs') and sgw:sgcollect-info (Sync Gateway's own collector, referenced via events 53300-53302 and the See Also link) independently exclude audit-log data from what they capture - the same documented non-support fact, arrived at independently for two different products' two different collection tools, with no page connecting the two.
